k: Gladiators: roll 2 hit dice and 1 hit location die; each hit deals your weapon’s power to that location, armor first, then HP. A limb at 0 is severed; a head or chest at 0 eliminates. A gladiator trophy is worth 10 CF.

Attack: roll 2 hit dice vs a gladiator (plus the hit location die), 4 vs a beast; each hit deals the weapon’s power (thrown weapons use their thrown numbers, a|b = normal|thrown). Armor first, then HP.
Power: damage dealt by each hit
Strikes twice: can make both of your turn’s attacks.
{0}'s aggro token moves to you. If {1} is already eliminated or tamed, gain 2 CF.
